mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate on future cash flows.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 315.0 (indicating persistent high inflation) triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as high inflation erodes corporate margins and prompts central bank tightening.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in the subset of days when CPIAUCSL > 315.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1250.0) signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in the subset of days when UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1250.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% and unemployment rate below 4.0%), a federal funds rate above 5.0% leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the economy is vulnerable to policy tightening.
failure_condition: In the subset of days when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower current industrial production (INDPRO) level is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as weaker industrial activity signals an economic slowdown.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) reading below 1200.0 (thousands) signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the housing sector is a key component of the economy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in the subset of days when HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong retail sales (RSAFS > 700,000.0) and robust housing starts (HOUST > 1250.0) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in the subset of days when RSAFS > 700000.0 and HOUST > 1250.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (computed from GDPC1) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong economic growth supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between GDPC1 growth rate and 60-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
